info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Prospect Campaign Execution API
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Execution API facilitates the retrieval of campaign execution details for banking sales prospects. It allows users to access the current status and results of various marketing initiatives targeted at potential clients. This API serves sales teams and marketing analysts who need to analyze the effectiveness of their prospect campaigns and optimize future efforts. By providing detailed insights, businesses can enhance their decision-making processes and improve customer engagement strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific sales prospect campaign execution.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a specific prospect campaign execution identified by its unique ID. It provides relevant data related to the campaign's execution status and metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details regarding the execution of a specific prospect campaign identified by the resource ID 'RES-100045'. It expects parameters conforming to the specified schema to tailor the response to the user's needs.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the response contains the requested data.
